facts.business: Alok Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of textiles including cotton yarn, apparel fabric, home textiles, and polyester yarn.

capacity_or_capex.item: Various Projects (mainly pertains to upgrading of plant and machinery)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects to avail all the working capital limits sanctioned to it in FY 26-27.

auditor.name: Chaturvedi & Shah LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on accounting of assigned debt at cost per NCLT resolution plan overriding Ind AS fair value requirement

key_risks: Credit risk from trade receivables and other financial assets
Market risk including interest rate risk, currency risk, and other price risk
Liquidity risk with current liabilities exceeding current assets primarily due to accumulated dividend on Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference shares of Rs 804.27 crore
Negative net worth leading to inability to calculate debt equity ratio
Impairment of loans to subsidiaries of Rs 1,465.99 crore fully provided for
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
